## Checklist for incident PRs

- [ ] File is `incidents/<year>/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<slug>.md`, copied from `incidents/_template.md`
- [ ] At least one **primary** source (vendor advisory or the researchers themselves)
- [ ] Numbers that only one outlet reports are marked as unverified
- [ ] Level follows the rubric in CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] `npm run build` passes locally (or let CI tell you)
